description: ネストした関数、関数タグの順序、return / return run / return fail、スコア条件、複数の実行者の順序
setup: data modify storage m2:calls failure set value {result:-1,success:-1}
data modify storage m2:calls trace set value []
data modify storage m2:calls executors set value []

m2:calls/plain: data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "plain"
data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "unreachable plain"
m2:calls/nested: data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "nested"
data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "unreachable nested"
m2:calls/fail: data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "fail"
data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "unreachable fail"
m2:calls/first: data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "first"
m2:calls/second: data modify storage m2:calls trace append value "second"
m2:calls/executor: execute store result storage m2:scratch identity int 1 run scoreboard players get @s identity
data modify storage m2:calls executors append from storage m2:scratch identity

actions.run: execute store result score #return result store success score #return_success result run function m2:calls/nested
execute store result storage m2:calls failure.result int 1 store success storage m2:calls failure.success int 1 run function m2:calls/fail
execute if score #return result matches 7 run function #m2:calls/ordered
execute if score #return result matches 8 run function m2:calls/fail
execute positioned 8 -60 8 as @e[type=marker,tag=worker,sort=nearest] run function m2:calls/executor
execute positioned 8 -60 8 as @e[type=marker,tag=worker,sort=furthest] run function m2:calls/executor
